name: Scanner
summary: Scan QR codes and barcodes from the island (links, Wi-Fi, UPI, contacts) and documents into a straightened PDF.

permissions.name: android.permission.CAMERA
permissions.reason: Reads codes and photographs documents, only while a scanner screen is open

privacy: Codes and pages are read on the phone and pictures aren't kept. PDFs are saved in Documents › Dynamic Island. No internet permission.
